### TETRA TECHNOLOGIES, INC. ANNOUNCES DATE FOR FIRST QUARTER 2026 EARNINGS CONFERENCE CALL


April 7, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/317475688/files/doc_news/TETRA-TECHNOLOGIES-INC--ANNOUNCES-DATE-FOR-FIRST-QUARTER-2026-EARNINGS-CONFERENCE-CALL-2026.pdf)


SPRING, Texas


, April 7, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- TETRA Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:TTI) will release First Quarter 2026 results after the market closes on April 29, 2026. Brady Murphy, President and CEO, and Matt Sanderson, CFO, will host a conference call to discuss the results and outlook on April 30, 2026, at 10:30am ET.


Conference call details: USA - Toll-Free(800) 715-9871


; Conference ID 1771643. Please visit the Events & Presentations section of the TETRA Technologies[website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4608147-1&h=3856631490&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.onetetra.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=website) to listen to the call via live webcast.


Company Overview
TETRA Technologies, Inc. is an energy services and solutions company focused on developing environmentally conscious services and solutions that help make people's lives better. With operations on six continents, the Company's portfolio consists of Energy Services, Industrial Chemicals, and Critical Minerals. In addition to providing products and services to the oil and gas industry and calcium chloride for diverse applications, TETRA is expanding into the low-carbon energy market with chemistry expertise, key mineral acreage, and global infrastructure, helping to meet the demand for sustainable energy in the twenty-first century. Visit the Company's website at[www.onetetra.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4659362-1&h=931392144&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.onetetra.com%2F&a=www.onetetra.com) for more information or connect with us on[LinkedIn.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4659362-1&h=2333490971&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Ftetra-technologies-inc-%2F&a=LinkedIn.)
